name: Azerbaijan Soviet Socialist Republic (1924–1927)
description: A red field with a yellow hammer and sickle and star in the upper hoist beside the republic's initials in yellow, in Cyrillic 'А.И.З.С.' above Arabic script.
history: Flag prescribed by the 1924 constitution of the Azerbaijan SSR, then a member of the Transcaucasian SFSR: the Soviet hammer, sickle and star with the republic's initials in both Cyrillic and Arabic script. The Latin alphabet replaced the Arabic on the flag in 1927.

features.role: initials in Cyrillic and Arabic script
